messages:
evie: Quick shoutout — raj rescued my terrible plant-care experiment and stayed to prop the pot so it doesn't flop. office plant lives to see another sprint. :seedling:
raj: haha no problem! also grabbed an extra charger from lost & found for the demo laptop. found it under the couch. :mag:
simon: huge thanks — that charger was going to be me panicking in 5 minutes. returning the favor by bringing donuts tomorrow morning (chocolate & cinnamon). :doughnut:
kate: extra kudos to reception for holding the spare HDMI cable this week. reception-bot: [auto] Item logged: HDMI-cable-02 (held at front desk). Claim with badge.
evie: small idea — we should start a tiny "helped a teammate" sticker roll. cheap, fun morale. who votes sticker vs pin vs cookie? :ballot_box_with_check:
raj: sticker all the way. wearable + low maintenance. :+1:
simon: cookie is tempting but messy. sticker wins.
kate: stickers it is. i'll order a 50-pack and bring a laminator for a few. thanks again everyone for jumping in — little wins like this make the week. :sparkles:
